lesson_title: A Whole World in One Book
hook_text: One book holds every country, every ocean and the population of the world. What is it?
clip_script: Mthatha, the school library. A box of new atlases. An atlas is a book of maps. Physical maps show mountains, rivers and height with colours. Political maps show countries, borders and capital cities. Thematic maps show one theme, like rainfall, climate or population. There are city maps, flags and tables of statistics: the biggest countries, the longest rivers, how many people live where. One book, the whole world.
visual_style: Whiteboard atlas opening, pages flipping to a physical map, a political map, a rainfall map and a statistics table.
mood: Curious and excited, like opening a treasure box.
pacing: Quick open, one page per kind of map, ending on the statistics table.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find three different kinds of maps in your own atlas.
